title: Mastering Diverse Domains through World Models
tldr: General model-based RL agent that learns a recurrent latent world model and trains actor-critic purely in imagined rollouts; fixed hyperparameters work across 150+ tasks and it was first to get Minecraft diamonds from scratch.
relevance_reason: Seed; canonical compact latent world model whose imagination-based learning underpins most later robot world-model RL.

title: TD-MPC2: Scalable, Robust World Models for Continuous Control
tldr: Improves TD-MPC into a scalable decoder-free latent world model that plans with sampling-based MPC in latent space; a single 317M agent handles 80 tasks across embodiments with one hyperparameter set.
relevance_reason: Seed; reference design for cheap latent-space online planning with a learned world model.

title: V-JEPA 2: Self-Supervised Video Models Enable Understanding, Prediction and Planning
reported_metric: ~16 s per action step for V-JEPA 2-AC planning vs ~4 min for a Cosmos video-generation baseline (per third-party summaries of the paper)
tldr: Pretrains a joint-embedding predictive video model on 1M+ hours of internet video, then post-trains a small action-conditioned latent predictor on <62h of DROID robot video to plan pick-and-place on Franka arms zero-shot via image-goal planning in representation space.
relevance_reason: Seed; shows latent (non-pixel) world models plan an order of magnitude faster than video-generation world models.

title: Cosmos World Foundation Model Platform for Physical AI
techniques: diffusion and autoregressive video world models
tldr: NVIDIA's open platform of pretrained video world foundation models (diffusion and autoregressive), tokenizers, and data curation, intended to be post-trained into robot or driving simulators and policies.
relevance_reason: Seed; the most widely used open backbone for robot world models and WAMs (Cosmos Policy, DreamDojo, Cosmos-H).

title: World Simulation with Video Foundation Models for Physical AI
tldr: Next-generation Cosmos world model unifying text/image/video-to-world generation with flow matching at 2B/14B scale; companion Cosmos-Transfer2.5 is 3.5x smaller than its predecessor; repo documents few-step distillation for faster rollout.
relevance_reason: Seed family (Cosmos); common backbone for efficient robot WAMs and distilled real-time simulators.

title: Genie: Generative Interactive Environments
tldr: Learns an action-controllable world model from unlabeled internet video by inferring discrete latent actions, allowing frame-by-frame interaction with generated environments and imitation from unseen videos.
relevance_reason: Seed (Genie 1); origin of latent-action world models reused in robot WAMs (DreamDojo, LAPA).

title: Learning Interactive Real-World Simulators
tldr: Trains a single video-diffusion simulator on heterogeneous data (robot, navigation, human, image) that responds to both language and low-level actions, and trains VLA and RL policies purely inside it that transfer zero-shot to real robots.
relevance_reason: Seed; early demonstration of learned video simulators for robot policy training (compute cost is the key bottleneck).

title: DreamDojo: A Generalist Robot World Model from Large-Scale Human Videos
reported_metric: 10.81 FPS real-time rollout after distillation
tldr: NVIDIA foundation robot world model pretrained on 44k hours of egocentric human video with continuous latent proxy actions; a distillation pipeline brings it to ~10.8 FPS for live teleoperation, policy evaluation and model-based planning.
relevance_reason: Seed; explicit real-time distillation of a large action-conditioned robot world model.

title: World Action Models are Zero-shot Policies
reported_metric: 7 Hz closed-loop control; 38x inference speedup from model+system optimizations
tldr: 14B world action model on a pretrained video diffusion backbone that jointly predicts future video and actions, doubling generalization over VLAs; a stack of algorithmic and systems optimizations gives 38x speedup to 7 Hz closed-loop control.
relevance_reason: Seed; flagship example of making a video-diffusion WAM run in real time.

title: Fast-WAM: Do World Action Models Need Test-time Future Imagination?
techniques: video co-training only at train time
reported_metric: 190 ms latency; >4x faster than imagine-then-execute WAMs
tldr: Shows WAMs keep most of their benefit if video prediction is used only as a training signal: the video DiT runs once as an encoder at test time, cutting latency to 190 ms (4x faster) with competitive success.
relevance_reason: Key efficiency finding for WAMs: test-time future imagination is largely unnecessary.
found_via: snowball from NVIDIA WAM blog / search

title: Faster-WAM: Do World Action Models Need Deep Action Modules?
techniques: single-layer action head docked to video backbone
reported_metric: 66.5 ms per inference; 3.2x faster than Fast-WAM
tldr: Replaces deep action towers in WAMs with a one-layer action head that reads keys/values from all layers of a 30-layer video transformer, giving the lowest latency in a controlled comparison without losing accuracy.
relevance_reason: Architectural latency reduction for WAMs with measured end-to-end timing.

title: Faster-WAM: Efficient Inference-Time Future Conditioning for Robust World Action Models
reported_metric: 2.21x faster than Joint-WAM; LIBERO-Plus success 49.1% -> 73.6% vs Fast-WAM
tldr: Argues inference-time future features matter for robustness, and keeps them cheaply by computing future representations once and fusing them only at a few network stages, beating Fast-WAM on OOD while staying 2.2x faster than joint WAMs.
relevance_reason: Efficiency/robustness trade-off analysis for WAM test-time imagination.

title: Efficient-WAM: A 1B-Parameter World-Action Model with Low-Cost Future Imagination
techniques: fewer video than action denoising steps
reported_metric: 98 ms per action chunk in physical deployment; >30x faster than Motus
tldr: A 1B WAM that treats future video as coarse guidance rather than a photoreal target, using token-sparse latents and asymmetric denoising to reach ~98 ms per chunk with success comparable to much larger WAMs.
relevance_reason: Direct small-WAM efficiency design with deployment latency.

title: Flash-WAM: Modality-Aware Distillation for World Action Models
reported_metric: per-chunk latency 8.1 s -> 348 ms (23x) on L40S
tldr: Step-distills a joint video-action WAM to one step per modality by choosing different consistency parametrizations for the low-noise action stream and high-noise video stream, giving 23x speedup while naive distillation collapses.
relevance_reason: Distillation specifically tailored to joint video-action world models.

title: Dyna-2: A 1-Million-Hour Scaling Law for World-Action Models
techniques: reactive policy (no future video at inference)
reported_metric: one-step distilled video generation 10,203 ms -> 110 ms (~90x) for 3 s three-view video
tldr: Dyna's WAM pretrained on 1M+ hours of egocentric human video shows a human-to-robot scaling law; the action stream is deliberately shallow for latency and runs reactively, while a distilled one-step video head cuts generation ~90x.
relevance_reason: Seed (DYNA-2); industrial WAM with explicit latency-driven design choices.

title: Genie 2: A large-scale foundation world model
tldr: Autoregressive latent video world model that turns a single image into a playable, action-controllable 3D environment with up to ~1 minute of consistency, used to train and evaluate embodied agents such as SIMA.
relevance_reason: Seed (Genie 2); foundation world model as an agent training environment.

title: Genie 3: A new frontier for world models
reported_metric: 24 fps at 720p, consistent for a few minutes
tldr: General-purpose world model generating text-prompted interactive environments in real time at 720p/24 fps with minutes-long consistency; tested as a training ground for the SIMA embodied agent. Limitations include a restricted action space and short interaction horizons.
relevance_reason: Seed (Genie 3); the reference point for real-time interactive world models.

title: Pretrained to Imagine, Fine-Tuned to Act: The Rise of World-Action Models
reported_metric: pi0.5 ~190 ms per chunk vs 590-800 ms for WAMs with full video generation (3-4x slowdown)
tldr: Overview that splits WAMs into inverse-dynamics, joint video-action, and representation-only designs, and points out that full video generation makes them 3-4x slower than VLAs, which is why skip-the-video variants are appearing.
relevance_reason: Practitioner overview of the latency cost of WAMs relative to VLAs.

title: 1X World Model: Evaluating Bits, not Atoms
tldr: Action-conditioned video world model for a full-body humanoid whose predicted success rates correlate with real-world evaluations, so candidate policies can be ranked in the model rather than on hardware.
relevance_reason: Industrial world model used as a cheap evaluation and monitoring substitute for real rollouts.

title: Efficient World Action Model Inference with Adaptive Intermediate States
reported_metric: 1.47-3.05x observation-to-action latency speedup; 2.23-3.27x GPU time per replan; 96.7-99.5% of native success retained
tldr: Training-free inference engine (WAMachine) that reuses and adapts denoising state across replans, denoising steps, and transformer layers, with consistency checks deciding when stale state must be recomputed.
relevance_reason: Generic training-free acceleration layer for WAM deployment.

title: MemoryWAM: Efficient World Action Modeling with Persistent Memory
techniques: hybrid memory (recent + anchor frames + gist tokens)
tldr: Adds bounded-cost persistent memory to a WAM by mixing recent frames, event-boundary anchors and compact summary tokens, so non-Markovian tasks are handled without the latency/memory growth of full history.
relevance_reason: Memory-efficiency for long-context world-action models.

title: Rolling-WAM: World Action Models with Rolling Imagination
techniques: rolling noise schedule across replanning cycles
reported_metric: 4.5x steady-state replanning speedup vs standard joint WAMs
tldr: Spreads joint video-action denoising over successive control cycles: near-term chunks are fully denoised for execution while farther chunks are partially refined and carried forward, amortizing compute.
relevance_reason: Diffusion-forcing style amortization for real-time WAM control.

title: AHA-WAM:Asynchronous Horizon-Adaptive World-Action Modeling with Observation-Guided Context Routing
techniques: low-frequency video DiT planner with rolling KV memory
reported_metric: 24.17 Hz closed-loop control; 4.59x speedup over Fast-WAM
tldr: Decouples the video world branch (slow, long-horizon context) from a fast action DiT that queries cached video context each step, so actions run at ~24 Hz without rerunning the video model.
relevance_reason: Dual-rate WAM reaching high closed-loop rates.

title: Motubrain: An Advanced World Action Model for Robot Control
reported_metric: up to 11 Hz inference; >50x speedup over naive baseline
tldr: Three-stream mixture-of-transformers WAM (policy, world model, inverse dynamics in one model) with a full deployment stack (fewer steps, FP8, caching, action-only mode) giving >50x speedup to ~11 Hz.
relevance_reason: End-to-end systems recipe for fast WAM deployment.

title: Latent Action as Intention Enables Efficient Future Imagination for World Action Models
techniques: joint denoising of latent state and actions
reported_metric: 42.9% lower inference latency than matched Joint-WAM at similar performance
tldr: Keeps test-time future imagination but in a compact latent-action space instead of pixels, recovering Joint-WAM generalization that Fast-WAM loses while cutting latency by ~43%.
relevance_reason: Middle ground between full imagination and none for WAM efficiency.

title: World Action Models in Real Time: An Empirical Study of Smooth Execution via Asynchronous Deployment
tldr: Empirical comparison of six ways to overlap slow WAM inference with execution; accurate timestamp alignment is essential and prefix-conditioned generation gives the best accuracy/smoothness balance.
relevance_reason: Practical guidance for running high-latency WAMs in real time.

title: Light-WAM: Efficient World Action Models with State-Fusion Action Decoding
reported_metric: 72.03 ms inference latency, 4.1 GiB peak GPU memory
tldr: Small WAM that uses future video only as downsampled training supervision and decodes action chunks in one forward pass from fused backbone states, giving ~72 ms latency and 4.1 GiB memory.
relevance_reason: Compact WAM with reported latency and memory.

title: ImageWAM: Do World Action Models Really Need Video Generation, or Just Image Editing?
techniques: pretrained image-editing model as world prior
action expert on editing KV caches
reported_metric: FLOPs 1/6 and latency 1/4 of video-based WAMs
tldr: Replaces video generation in WAMs with a single-target-frame image-editing prior whose KV caches condition a flow-matching action expert, cutting compute 6x and latency 4x.
relevance_reason: Cheaper world prior for WAMs.

title: GigaWorld-Policy-0.5: A Faster and Stronger WAM Empowered by AutoResearch
reported_metric: 85 ms inference latency
tldr: Action-centered WAM that trains on future visual dynamics but decodes only actions at test time through a separated MoT expert, reaching 85 ms latency on a local RTX 4090.
relevance_reason: WAM with local consumer-GPU latency number.

title: Keep the Future, Drop the Rollout: RIFT for World Action Models
techniques: learned anticipation tokens producing future K/V cache in one pass
reported_metric: 3.1-9.2x inference speedup; LIBERO 98.8%
tldr: Shows actions depend on the final future K/V cache rather than the rollout trajectory, then learns tokens that produce that cache in one backbone pass (RIFT), eliminating iterative video generation at deployment.
relevance_reason: Mechanistic analysis plus a large WAM speedup.

title: QuantWAMs: Calibrating at the Right Granularity for World Action Models
reported_metric: peak weight+activation memory ~29% of FP16; 1.4-1.6x block-level speedup; 0.2-0.7 pp gap to FP16
tldr: PTQ framework for WAMs that calibrates on closed-loop rollout states and joint video-action objectives, reaching W4A4 with sub-1-point loss and about 3.4x memory reduction on targeted blocks.
relevance_reason: First WAM-specific low-bit quantization study.

title: Flex-$π$: A Multi-Stream World-Action Model with Compute Flexibility
reported_metric: runs faster than pi0.5 in action-only mode (per abstract)
tldr: 6B WAM supervised on RGB, 3D pointmaps and DINO semantics in a shared VAE latent; stream dropout lets one checkpoint run anything from fast action-only inference to full joint generation.
relevance_reason: Compute-adjustable WAM inference.

title: LaWAM: Latent World Action Models for Efficient Dynamics-Aware Robot Policies
reported_metric: 187 ms per action-chunk; up to 24x lower wall-clock latency than pixel-space WAMs
tldr: Conditions the policy on predicted future features in a frozen vision-foundation-model latent space instead of generated video, keeping foresight while being up to 24x faster than pixel WAMs.
relevance_reason: Latent-space foresight for fast WAMs.

title: WAM4D: Fast 4D World Action Model via Spatial Register Tokens
tldr: Transfers 3D geometric priors into a causal video-action transformer through lightweight register tokens used only during training, so inference stays as cheap as a 2D WAM.
relevance_reason: Adds 3D awareness without inference cost.

title: GlanceWAM: Sparse Test-Time Imagination for World-Action Models
techniques: background single-frame lookahead on slow clock
reported_metric: 48 ms per action chunk; 24x faster than synchronous baselines
tldr: Imagines one future frame seconds ahead on a slow background clock while a latent action head decodes chunks every 48 ms, beating both synchronous Cosmos Policy and imagination-free co-training.
relevance_reason: Takes imagination off the critical path of a WAM.

title: MoWAM: Explicit Future Motion Prediction for Efficient World Action Models
techniques: explicit compact motion prediction replaces video
tldr: Swaps future video generation for prediction of compact future robot motion, which is cheap enough to sample several motion-action candidates and pick one with a task-progress verifier.
relevance_reason: Compact future representation enabling cheap test-time planning.

title: Rethink Before You Execute: Adaptive Execution for World Action Models
reported_metric: 26.9% fewer WAM inferences on easy real tasks at equal success; +13.3 pp on hard tasks
tldr: Plug-in monitor (TempoWAM) that estimates task progress online and replans only when a chunk stops advancing the task, cutting inference calls and improving success on difficult tasks.
relevance_reason: Monitoring-driven compute reduction for WAMs.

title: Vid2WAM: Distilling Video Diffusion Priors into World Action Models
techniques: offline distillation from video foundation model
tldr: Distills future rollouts from a large video model plus IDM pseudo-actions into a compact WAM student; teacher and IDM are dropped at deployment, keeping inference low-latency.
relevance_reason: Teacher-student distillation from video foundation models into small WAMs.

title: Streaming-WAM: Action-Conditioned World-Action Model for Asynchronous Robot Manipulation
techniques: action-conditioned future prediction on committed prefix
reported_metric: episode time 2.93x shorter than Fast-WAM on LIBERO; real task 90 s -> 38 s
tldr: Makes asynchronous WAM execution consistent by conditioning future visual prediction on the actions already committed during inference, then generating the rest of the chunk from those predictions.
relevance_reason: Correct asynchronous inference for high-latency WAMs.

title: ForgeWM: Progressive Causal Training for Few-Step Action-Conditioned Video World Models
tldr: Four-stage recipe converting a bidirectional action-conditioned video generator into 1-, 2- or 4-step causal world models with accurate control response, plus optional replay-time refinement.
relevance_reason: General few-step action-conditioned world-model recipe (games, transferable to robots).

title: WAM-OPD: On-Policy Distillation for World Action Models
tldr: Repairs capability lost by step-distilled WAM students by letting the student act and having a frozen teacher label its own histories; preliminary gains on two RoboTwin tasks.
relevance_reason: Addresses accuracy loss from WAM acceleration.

title: ReSync: Re-Aligning the Two Clocks of Asynchronous World-Action Models
techniques: hold action state while advancing video stream
tldr: Formalizes the mismatch when actions finish denoising before the video stream and gives a parameter-free rule for how much extra world computation to spend before committing an action.
relevance_reason: Principled compute allocation for dual-schedule WAMs.

title: FBFM: A Training-Free Asynchronous Feedback Mechanism for Flow-Matching in World-Action Models Execution
techniques: masked pseudoinverse correction of velocity field
tldr: Training-free inference change that injects the latest real observation and prior actions into the flow-matching velocity field inside a chunk, reducing drift in asynchronous WAM execution.
relevance_reason: Improves reliability of async WAM rollouts.

title: Foresight Without Seeing: Latent Futures for World Action Models
techniques: single video-DiT prefill producing future K/V
tldr: Gives a direct-policy WAM access to predicted dynamics via one prefill pass over current latents plus stochastic future slots, with no future video decoding at deployment.
relevance_reason: Cheap implicit foresight for WAMs.

title: Unified 4D World Action Modeling from Video Priors with Asynchronous Denoising
techniques: asynchronous noise sampling (few steps for actions, full for video)
reported_metric: action latency 4665 ms -> 1033 ms (4.5x) with asynchronous inference (per search summary)
tldr: Unified RGB-D video + action model that decodes actions in a few steps for real-time execution while the video stream keeps its full denoising schedule for 4D synthesis.
relevance_reason: Asynchronous denoising to decouple action latency from world-model fidelity.

title: Causal World Modeling for Robot Control
tldr: Autoregressive diffusion WAM that predicts frames and actions together and pipelines action prediction with motor execution; widely used as a base for later WAM acceleration work.
relevance_reason: Base model for several efficiency papers (Flash-WAM, QuantWAMs).

title: mimic-video: Video-Action Models for Generalizable Robot Control Beyond VLAs
tldr: Pairs an internet-scale video model with a flow-matching inverse-dynamics decoder that reads its latent video plans, giving 10x sample efficiency over VLA baselines.
relevance_reason: Representative inverse-dynamics WAM; relevant to compute trade-offs of video planning.

title: Cosmos Policy: Fine-Tuning Video Models for Visuomotor Control and Planning
tldr: Post-trains a pretrained video diffusion model to output action chunks, future states and values as extra latent frames, making one model a policy, world model and value function usable for test-time planning.
relevance_reason: Unifies world model and policy; planning variant highlights compute cost of imagination.

title: Video Prediction Policy: A Generalist Robot Policy with Predictive Visual Representations
techniques: implicit inverse dynamics on video diffusion features
tldr: Uses internal features from a single forward pass of a fine-tuned video diffusion model as predictive representations for an action head, avoiding full video generation while gaining future awareness.
relevance_reason: Early representation-only WAM that sidesteps costly video denoising.

title: Cortex 2.0: Grounding World Models in Real-World Industrial Deployment
techniques: candidate future generation in visual latent space
tldr: Industrial system that rolls out candidate futures in a visual latent space, scores them for success and efficiency, and executes the best one, outperforming reactive VLAs in cluttered, contact-rich settings.
relevance_reason: Latent-space world-model planning in real industrial deployment.

title: GE-Act 2.0: Pretraining and Scaling a World-Action Model for Robotic Manipulation
tldr: AgiBot WAM trained from scratch with a compressive control-oriented autoencoder and a single-step visual planner that produces the full future state in one pass, scaled to 30k hours of co-training data.
relevance_reason: One-pass (non-iterative) visual planner design for efficient WAMs.

title: Genie Envisioner: A Unified World Foundation Platform for Robotic Manipulation
reported_metric: slow-fast asynchronous mode: video at 5 Hz, actions at 30 Hz; 54-step trajectory within 200 ms (per search summary)
tldr: AgiBot platform unifying a video world foundation model, a lightweight action decoder for policies, and an action-conditioned neural simulator for closed-loop evaluation, with a benchmark for embodied world models.
relevance_reason: Industrial WAM + neural simulator with slow-fast inference.

title: MotionWAM: Towards Foundation World Action Models for Real-Time Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
techniques: policy conditioned on intermediate video-denoising features
tldr: Real-time WAM for humanoid whole-body loco-manipulation from one egocentric camera, reading intermediate video-denoising features instead of finished video and predicting unified whole-body motion tokens.
relevance_reason: Real-time WAM on humanoid via partial denoising.

title: Metis: A Generalizable and Efficient World-Action Model for Autonomous Driving and Urban Navigation
tldr: Driving/navigation WAM whose action expert can skip explicit video generation at inference thanks to an asymmetric attention mask used during joint training.
relevance_reason: Efficient WAM for driving/navigation.

title: SV-WAM: An Efficient Surround-View World-Action Model for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
tldr: Keeps six-camera input in a driving WAM by using future-video prediction only as training supervision and discarding the video branch at deployment.
relevance_reason: Same efficiency pattern for driving WAMs.

title: PhyAI: Real-Time Physical AI at the Edge, Scalable Rollouts in the Cloud
reported_metric: 1.40-4.65x over official pi0/pi0.5/GR00T/MiniCPM-Robot; Cosmos3-Nano-Policy latency 2.46 s -> 1.18 s on 8 H20
tldr: Single inference runtime serving both VLAs and WAMs across onboard, edge and cloud, with profiling that shows why diffusion action experts dominate batch-1 latency.
relevance_reason: Systems support for deploying WAMs.

title: Embodied.cpp: A Portable Inference Runtime of Embodied AI Models on Heterogeneous Robots
reported_metric: 1.05-2.70x inference speedups and 7-77% lower VRAM vs Python baselines (3 VLAs, 2 WAMs)
tldr: llama.cpp-style portable runtime for VLAs and WAMs on heterogeneous edge devices, supporting multi-rate closed-loop execution.
relevance_reason: Deployment runtime that includes WAMs.

title: ForeTime-VLA: Causal Future-Token Distillation from a World Action Model for Conveyor-Belt Manipulation
techniques: distill WAM future representation into VLA
reported_metric: 2.46-2.93% latency overhead vs base pi0.5
tldr: Distills a compact 64-D future-aware target from a frozen WAM teacher into a pi0.5 policy, so the VLA anticipates moving objects with ~3% latency overhead and no teacher at runtime.
relevance_reason: World-model knowledge transferred to a fast policy.

title: World-Action Models for Robot Learning and Control: A Survey
tldr: Robotics-focused survey organizing WAMs by representation, transition model, action interface and training pipeline, and listing efficient inference as an open challenge.
relevance_reason: Survey covering WAM efficiency.

title: From World Models to World Action Models: A Concise Tutorial for Robotics
tldr: Short tutorial defining world models vs world action models and comparing spatial-intelligence models, JEPA and Cosmos.
relevance_reason: Background tutorial.

title: Native Video-Action Pretraining for Generalizable Robot Control
tldr: Video-action foundation model built from scratch for embodiment, using a sparse MoE backbone for capacity without latency and asynchronous latent prediction re-grounded on the latest observation.
relevance_reason: Designed for high-frequency WAM inference.

title: DriftWorld: Fast World Modeling through Drifting
reported_metric: 30+ fps single-pass generation; 17x faster on average than diffusion world models
tldr: Action-conditioned world model built on drifting generative models that produces future frames in one forward pass, making it cheap to score many candidate action sequences for planning and policy ranking (r up to 0.99).
relevance_reason: Directly targets rollout speed as the planning bottleneck.

title: DDP-WM: Disentangled Dynamics Prediction for Efficient World Models
techniques: decompose foreground interaction vs background updates
reported_metric: ~9x inference speedup on Push-T; MPC success 90% -> 98%
tldr: Splits latent dynamics into sparse interaction-driven tokens and cheap background updates, giving ~9x faster rollouts and better MPC success than dense DINO-WM-style models.
relevance_reason: Efficient latent world model for MPC with speedup numbers.

title: DVG-WM: Disentangled Video Generation Enables Efficient Embodied World Model for Robotic Manipulation
techniques: flow matching from dynamics to video latents
reported_metric: up to 3.97x acceleration
tldr: Separates low-level dynamics prediction from high-resolution rendering in a robot video world model, giving up to ~4x faster generation with better contact detail.
relevance_reason: Efficient embodied video world model.

title: RoboFlow4D: A Lightweight Flow World Model Toward Real-Time Flow-Guided Robotic Manipulation
tldr: Lightweight world model predicting multi-frame 3D scene flow from images and text to guide an action policy, run in a slow-fast loop for real-time manipulation.
relevance_reason: Compact flow-based world model for real-time planning.

title: WEAVER, Better, Faster, Longer: An Effective World Model for Robotic Manipulation
tldr: Multi-view latent world model designed for fidelity, long-horizon consistency and speed; used on hardware for policy evaluation (rho=0.87), policy improvement (+38% over pi0.5) and test-time planning.
relevance_reason: Efficiency is an explicit design goal alongside fidelity for planning/evaluation.

title: RoboWorld: Fast and Reliable Neural Simulators for Generalist Robot Policy Evaluation
reported_metric: Pearson r=0.989 with real-world evaluation
tldr: Automated policy-evaluation pipeline pairing a fast autoregressive video world model with a progress-aware VLM judge; Step Forcing reduces train-test mismatch for long rollouts.
relevance_reason: Fast world model for scalable evaluation.

title: Scope-WM: Scoped Computation for Efficient Visual World Models
techniques: reuse of good action sequences in MPC
tldr: Restricts dynamics computation to prediction-relevant tokens chosen by a small distilled selector and reuses promising action sequences across MPC iterations, cutting latency and peak memory for planning.
relevance_reason: Latency/memory-efficient world model planning for constrained platforms.

title: Sparse Imagination for Efficient Visual World Model Planning
tldr: Trains a transformer world model to tolerate processing only a subset of tokens, so planning rollouts can be run sparsely according to the available compute budget.
relevance_reason: Compute-adaptive latent rollouts for robot planning.

title: Inference-Time Enhancement of Generative Robot Policies via Predictive World Modeling
techniques: action-conditioned world model ranking policy proposals
tldr: Improves a frozen diffusion policy at deployment by predicting outcomes of its action proposals with a world model and ranking/refining them; rollouts dominate runtime, motivating faster world models.
relevance_reason: Canonical test-time world-model planning baseline (rollout cost bottleneck cited by DriftWorld).

title: RealWonder: Real-Time Physical Action-Conditioned Video Generation
tldr: Real-time action-conditioned video generation that runs actions through a physics simulator to optical flow, then renders with a 4-step distilled video model at ~13 FPS.
relevance_reason: Real-time physically grounded action-conditioned world model.

title: NVIDIA Cosmos-H-Dreams: Real-Time Generative Physics Simulation for Surgical Robotics
techniques: bidirectional teacher to causal few-step student
reported_metric: ~160 inference FPS streaming
benchmarks: surgical robot control (Versius console, VR, policies)
tldr: Distills an action-conditioned surgical video world model into a causal few-step student that streams at ~160 FPS on one workstation GPU, driven live by consoles, VR or learned policies.
relevance_reason: Concrete real-time distillation of a Cosmos robot world model with hardware numbers.

title: minWM: A Full-Stack Open-Source Framework for Real-Time Interactive Video World Models
tldr: End-to-end open pipeline that turns bidirectional video diffusion models into camera-controllable few-step autoregressive world models for low-latency rollout.
relevance_reason: Tooling for real-time interactive world models (non-robot actions).

title: Interactive World Simulator for Robot Policy Training and Evaluation
reported_metric: 15 FPS, stable >10 min interaction
tldr: Builds a fast pixel-level robot world model from moderate data using consistency models for both dynamics and decoding, stable for 10+ minutes at 15 FPS on one 4090; policies trained on its data match real-data policies.
relevance_reason: Real-time robot world simulator on consumer GPU.

title: Scalable Policy Evaluation with Video World Models
techniques: adding action conditioning to pretrained video generators
tldr: NVIDIA study adding action conditioning to pretrained video generators for robot policy evaluation, analyzing data diversity, pretraining and failure cases.
relevance_reason: World models as cheap evaluators.

title: Evaluating Gemini Robotics Policies in a Veo World Simulator
tldr: Google DeepMind adapts Veo into an action-conditioned multi-view simulator to evaluate Gemini Robotics policies on nominal, OOD and physical/semantic safety scenarios produced by editing real scenes.
relevance_reason: World model used for safety probing of robot foundation policies.

title: WorldEval: World Model as Real-World Robot Policies Evaluator
tldr: Turns a video generator into a latent-action-following simulator to rank real-robot policies and checkpoints, and to act as a safety detector that flags dangerous actions from new models before deployment.
relevance_reason: World model as policy evaluator and pre-deployment safety screen.

title: WorldGym: World Model as An Environment for Policy Evaluation
tldr: Autoregressive action-conditioned video world model used as an evaluation environment; in-model success rates correlate with real-world success and preserve policy rankings.
relevance_reason: World-model-based evaluation.

title: World-Gymnast: Training Robots with Reinforcement Learning in a World Model
techniques: RL rollouts inside action-conditioned video world model
tldr: RL-finetunes a VLA entirely inside a video world model with VLM rewards, outperforming SFT by up to 18x and a software simulator by 2x on real Bridge tasks.
relevance_reason: World model replaces costly real interaction; rollout speed is a bottleneck.

title: WMPO: World Model-based Policy Optimization for Vision-Language-Action Models
techniques: pixel-space world model aligned with VLA features
tldr: On-policy RL for VLAs inside a pixel-space video world model, improving sample efficiency and producing emergent self-correction without real-environment interaction.
relevance_reason: World-model-based VLA post-training.

title: iVideoGPT: Interactive VideoGPTs are Scalable World Models
tldr: Scalable autoregressive world model whose compressive tokenizer keeps token counts low enough for interactive use, pretrained on millions of human/robot trajectories.
relevance_reason: Token-compression approach to efficient interactive world models.

title: Learning Real-World Action-Video Dynamics with Heterogeneous Masked Autoregression
reported_metric: 15x faster than previous robotic video generation models
tldr: Masked-autoregressive action-video world model pretrained across embodiments, running ~15x faster than prior robot video generators for real-time simulation and evaluation.
relevance_reason: Efficiency-focused robot world model architecture.

title: QuantWM: Temporally Consistent 2-Bit KV Cache Quantization for Video World Models
tldr: Shows standard 2-bit KV quantization causes flicker in video world models because key errors shift attention, and fixes it with sensitivity-aware key centroids so KV memory can be cut to 2 bits.
relevance_reason: Memory compression for long-context world models.

title: Fast Autoregressive Video Diffusion and World Models with Temporal Cache Compression and Sparse Attention
tldr: Training-free attention framework for autoregressive video diffusion/world models that bounds KV growth via temporal correspondence and sparsifies attention with approximate nearest neighbors.
relevance_reason: General acceleration for AR world models.

title: X-Cache: Cross-Chunk Block Caching for Few-Step Autoregressive World Models Inference
tldr: Caches block residuals across consecutive generation chunks rather than denoising steps, accelerating already few-step autoregressive driving world models without training.
relevance_reason: Caching tailored to distilled interactive world models.

title: Q-ARVD: Quantizing Autoregressive Video Diffusion Models
tldr: Characterizes why standard DiT quantization fails for autoregressive video diffusion (skewed frame sensitivity, heterogeneous outliers) and proposes a tailored PTQ scheme.
relevance_reason: Quantization for the backbone class used by streaming world models.

title: Self Forcing: Bridging the Train-Test Gap in Autoregressive Video Diffusion
reported_metric: real-time streaming with sub-second latency on a single GPU
tldr: Trains autoregressive video diffusion on its own rollouts with few-step sampling and a rolling KV cache, enabling real-time streaming generation; now the standard recipe for distilling robot world models (e.g., Cosmos-H-Dreams).
relevance_reason: Foundational technique used by real-time robot world models.

title: Rolling Forcing: Autoregressive Long Video Diffusion in Real Time
techniques: joint denoising with increasing noise levels
tldr: Real-time streaming long-video generation that denoises a window of frames at staggered noise levels with an attention sink, limiting error accumulation.
relevance_reason: Foundational streaming technique mirrored by Rolling-WAM.

title: Matrix-game 2.0: An open-source, real-time, and streaming interactive world model
reported_metric: 25 FPS minute-level generation
tldr: Open-source interactive world model using few-step causal autoregressive diffusion with keyboard/mouse action injection, streaming at 25 FPS.
relevance_reason: Open real-time interactive world model recipe (games).

title: Matrix-Game 3.0: Real-Time and Streaming Interactive World Model with Long-Horizon Memory
tldr: Memory-augmented interactive world model targeting 720p real-time long-form generation, adding self-correction training and camera-aware memory to the Matrix-Game 2.0 recipe.
relevance_reason: State of the art in real-time interactive world models with memory.

title: Playing with Transformer at 30+ FPS via Next-Frame Diffusion
reported_metric: 30+ FPS
tldr: Autoregressive next-frame diffusion transformer made real-time via video consistency distillation and speculative generation of several frames under the current action, discarding them if the action changes.
relevance_reason: Speculative decoding idea for action-conditioned world models.

title: Inferix: A Block-Diffusion based Next-Generation Inference Engine for World Simulation
tldr: Inference engine specialized for block-diffusion (semi-autoregressive) world simulators, bringing LLM-style KV cache management to interactive video world models.
relevance_reason: Serving infrastructure for world models.

title: Video Generation Models as World Models: Efficient Paradigms, Architectures and Algorithms
techniques: survey: efficient paradigms, architectures, inference algorithms
tldr: Survey of efficiency techniques for video-generation world models organized into modeling paradigms, network architectures and inference algorithms, with embodied AI and driving as target applications.
relevance_reason: Directly maps the efficient world-model design space.

title: Waypoint-1.5: A Real-Time Video World Model for Consumer Hardware
tldr: Real-time interactive diffusion world model trained on 100k hours of game video that runs on consumer hardware, and usefully separates rendered FPS, latent FPS and control rate as metrics.
relevance_reason: Clarifies real-time world-model metrics on cheap hardware.

title: Vid2World: Crafting Video Diffusion Models to Interactive World Models
tldr: Converts pretrained bidirectional video diffusion models into autoregressive, action-controllable interactive world models by causalizing architecture and training objective.
relevance_reason: Standard route from video models to interactive world models.

title: World-in-World: World Models in a Closed-Loop World
tldr: Benchmark that tests world models by task success in closed-loop planning rather than visual quality, finding controllability matters more than fidelity and reporting data/compute scaling for inference-time planning.
relevance_reason: Evaluation of world models for planning utility (incl. inference compute).

title: BWM: A Low-Cost High-Fidelity World Simulator for Robot Learning
tldr: Open-source low-cost action-conditioned robot world model used both as a data engine and as a closed-loop evaluator that anticipates risky outcomes before execution.
relevance_reason: Cheap world simulator with risk anticipation use.

title: CausalDrive: Real-time Causal World Models for Autonomous Driving
tldr: Real-time controllable driving world renderer that predicts reactive agent behavior from ego trajectory and text, using a distillation scheme to remove diffusion latency for closed-loop policy learning.
relevance_reason: Real-time distilled world model for closed-loop driving.

title: VectorWorld: Efficient Streaming World Model via Diffusion Flow on Vector Graphs
tldr: Streaming driving world model over lane/agent vector graphs with solver-free one-step generation to meet real-time closed-loop budgets.
relevance_reason: Compact non-pixel world model for real-time simulation.

title: DreamerAD: Efficient Reinforcement Learning via Latent World Model for Autonomous Driving
reported_metric: diffusion sampling 100 -> 1 step, 80x speedup (from ~2 s/frame)
tldr: Makes RL in a driving video world model practical by compressing sampling from 100 steps to 1 (80x) with shortcut forcing and doing credit assignment with a latent reward model.
relevance_reason: Step compression of world models for fast imagination RL.

title: $I^{2}$-World: Intra-Inter Tokenization for Efficient Dynamic 4D Scene Forecasting
tldr: Efficient occupancy world model that compresses 3D scenes with separate spatial and temporal tokenizers for fast 4D forecasting in driving.
relevance_reason: Token-efficient 3D world model.

title: DINO-WM: World Models on Pre-trained Visual Features enable Zero-shot Planning
tldr: Predicts future DINOv2 patch features instead of pixels and plans action sequences toward goal features, enabling task-agnostic zero-shot planning without reconstruction cost.
relevance_reason: Reference latent world model for efficient planning; baseline for most sparse/efficient WM work.

title: What Drives Success in Physical Planning with Joint-Embedding Predictive World Models?
techniques: study of architecture, objective, planner for JEPA world models
tldr: Systematic study of what makes planning in JEPA world model latent space work (architecture, loss, planner), yielding a model that beats DINO-WM and V-JEPA 2-AC.
relevance_reason: Design guidance for latent planners, the efficient alternative to pixel world models.

title: Value-guided action planning with JEPA world models
tldr: Shapes JEPA embeddings so that latent distance approximates a goal-conditioned value, making simple distance-based planning far more effective.
relevance_reason: Improves latent planning quality cheaply.

title: Temporal Straightening for Latent Planning
tldr: Regularizes JEPA latent trajectories to be locally straight so Euclidean distance tracks geodesic distance, making gradient-based latent planning more stable and successful.
relevance_reason: Enables cheaper gradient planning in latent world models.

title: Hierarchical Planning with Latent World Models
tldr: Hierarchical MPC over latent world models at several temporal scales with compressed macro-actions, keeping long-horizon search tractable and reducing planning cost on real Franka tasks.
relevance_reason: Reduces exponential planning cost of latent world-model MPC.

title: FF-JEPA: Long-Horizon Planning in World Models with Latent Planners
techniques: action-free subgoal predictor + action-conditioned forward model
tldr: Adds an action-free latent subgoal predictor to a JEPA world model, replacing expensive long-horizon CEM with a sequence of short optimizations and removing the need for goal images.
relevance_reason: Cheaper long-horizon latent planning (preliminary).

title: D-JEPA: A Decision-Aligned Latent World Model
techniques: permutation-equivariant ordinal operator over candidate futures
tldr: Aligns JEPA latent geometry with which candidate actually succeeds when executed, fixing cases where the predicted-closest future is the wrong choice while keeping native latent-distance planning.
relevance_reason: Improves reliability of cheap latent planning.

title: LRC-JEPA: Disentangling Dynamics and Residual Context for Efficient World Models
techniques: compact predictive latent + residual context embeddings
only compact latent propagated for planning
tldr: Lightweight JEPA world model that routes appearance into a separate residual context so only a small dynamic latent is rolled out for planning, matching much larger pretrained models.
relevance_reason: Small latent world model for efficient planning.

title: V-JEPA 2.1: Unlocking Dense Features in Video Self-Supervised Learning
tldr: Successor to V-JEPA 2 with dense spatially grounded features that substantially improve real-robot grasping through latent planning.
relevance_reason: Seed follow-up (V-JEPA line).

title: DUET-DINO: Simultaneous Cross-View World Modeling for Latent Planning in Robot Manipulation
tldr: Joint side- and wrist-camera latent world model that makes zero-shot latent planning reliable for full 7-DoF control, and finds V-JEPA 2 wrist predictions underestimate fine action effects.
relevance_reason: Latent planning on real robots (V-JEPA 2-AC follow-up).

title: Does Latent Planning Survive Point Clouds? Action-Conditioned JEPA World Models for Geometric Observations and Goals
techniques: JEPA world models on raycast point clouds
tldr: Tests whether JEPA latent planning transfers from images to point-cloud observations and pose-specified goals, comparing anti-collapse designs.
relevance_reason: Extends latent planning modality.

title: JEPA-WAM: Learning Vision-Language-Action Policies with Joint-Embedding World Modeling
techniques: latent transition prediction in V-JEPA space
tldr: WAM built in V-JEPA latent space that couples latent transition prediction and action generation through one predictor, avoiding video-generation deployment cost.
relevance_reason: JEPA route to cheap WAMs.

title: Bilinear World Models: Learning Representations with Structured Dynamics for Efficient Control
reported_metric: planning time reduced by nearly three orders of magnitude
tldr: Constrains JEPA latent dynamics to a bilinear form so planning becomes nearly closed-form, cutting planning time ~1000x while keeping control accuracy.
relevance_reason: Structural route to very fast latent planning.

title: R2-Dreamer: Redundancy-Reduced World Models without Decoders or Augmentation
reported_metric: trains 1.59x faster than DreamerV3
tldr: Removes the pixel decoder from Dreamer and prevents collapse with a Barlow-Twins-style objective, matching DreamerV3/TD-MPC2 while training ~1.6x faster.
relevance_reason: Cheaper latent world models (DreamerV3 follow-up).

title: Discrete Codebook World Models for Continuous Control
tldr: Shows discrete codebook latent states beat continuous latents for continuous control and builds a TD-MPC2-style planner on them (DCWM).
relevance_reason: Latent representation choice for efficient planning world models.

title: EfficientTDMPC: Improved MPC Objectives for Sample-Efficient Continuous Control
reported_metric: reaches BMPC final performance with 57% fewer environment steps
tldr: Reduces model and value error in TD-MPC planning with multi-horizon returns and a dynamics ensemble, setting sample-efficiency SOTA on HumanoidBench/DMC.
relevance_reason: Sample efficiency rather than compute efficiency of latent MPC.

title: COMponent-Aware Pruning for Accelerated Control Tasks in Latent Space Models
tldr: Compresses TD-MPC latent world-model controllers with component-aware structured pruning while checking Lyapunov stability, targeting resource-constrained robots.
relevance_reason: Compression of a latent world-model planner for edge deployment.

title: TD-MPC-Opt: Distilling Model-Based Multi-Task Reinforcement Learning Agents
reported_metric: MT30 normalized score 28.45 vs 18.93 for native 1M; ~50% size reduction from FP16
tldr: Distills a 317M multi-task TD-MPC2 world-model agent into a 1M-parameter model that beats a natively trained 1M model, then halves size with FP16 quantization.
relevance_reason: World-model agent distillation for constrained hardware.

title: TD-M(PC)$^2$: Improving Temporal Difference MPC Through Policy Constraint
techniques: policy regularization reducing OOD value queries
tldr: Fixes value overestimation in TD-MPC2 caused by planner/policy mismatch with a zero-overhead policy constraint, especially helping high-DoF humanoids.
relevance_reason: Latent MPC improvement without added compute.

title: Temporal Difference Learning for Model Predictive Control
tldr: Original TD-MPC: short-horizon planning in a decoder-free latent model with a learned terminal value, cutting the cost of long-horizon planning.
relevance_reason: Foundation of efficient latent MPC.

title: Think Fast, Plan Selectively: Adaptive Deliberation for Efficient Data-Driven MPC
techniques: routing between policy prior and MPC planning
reported_metric: up to ~4x faster inference across 103 tasks
tldr: Routes each step either to a cheap policy or to full world-model MPC, planning only where needed, for up to 4x faster control with robustness under disturbances.
relevance_reason: Adaptive compute for world-model planning.

title: ELVIS: Ensemble-Calibrated Latent Imagination for Long-Horizon Visual MPC
tldr: Makes long-horizon Dreamer-style latent MPC reliable with multi-modal MPPI and uncertainty-gated returns that limit compounding model error.
relevance_reason: Uncertainty-aware latent planning.

title: FlowMPC: Improving Flow Matching policies with World Models
tldr: Adds TD-MPC2-style world-model planning over flow-matching policy proposals, improving ManiSkill success without retraining the policy.
relevance_reason: Small study of test-time world-model planning.

title: MODIP: Efficient Model-Based Optimization for Diffusion Policies
techniques: MPC in world model generates BC targets
terminal state value for cheaper planning
tldr: Fine-tunes diffusion policies with trajectories planned in a world model, using a terminal state value to cut MPC inference cost.
relevance_reason: Efficient world-model planning to improve policies.

title: MinD: Learning A Dual-System World Model for Real-Time Planning and Implicit Risk Analysis
techniques: asynchronous low-frequency video diffusion + high-frequency diffusion policy
tldr: Dual-rate world model where a slow video diffuser produces one-step low-resolution latents that guide a fast diffusion policy, and whose predictions also serve as implicit risk signals.
relevance_reason: Combines real-time planning and risk analysis with a world model.

title: Uncertainty-aware Latent Safety Filters for Avoiding Out-of-Distribution Failures
tldr: Augments latent HJ reachability with the world model's calibrated epistemic uncertainty so the safety filter also avoids hazards the world model has never seen.
relevance_reason: Core imagination-based safety monitoring method.

title: Generalizing Safety Beyond Collision-Avoidance via Latent-Space Reachability Analysis
techniques: reachability analysis in generative world model latent space
tldr: Performs Hamilton-Jacobi reachability in a world model's latent space so robots can avoid failures specified only visually (e.g., spilling), overriding any base policy when needed.
relevance_reason: Founding latent safety filter work.

title: AnySafe: Adapting Latent Safety Filters at Runtime via Safety Constraint Parameterization in the Latent Space
tldr: Lets latent safety filters accept new user-specified constraints at runtime by conditioning on an image of the constraint, calibrated with conformal prediction and trained entirely in imagination.
relevance_reason: Adaptable world-model safety monitor.

title: Designing Latent Safety Filters using Pre-Trained Vision Models
techniques: PVR backbones for failure classifiers, HJ filters and latent world models
tldr: Studies how frozen, fine-tuned or scratch pretrained vision encoders work as backbones for failure classifiers, HJ safety filters and latent world models, with deployment considerations.
relevance_reason: Design study for world-model-based safety filters.

title: When World Models Lie: Adaptive Safety Analysis Under Wrong Imaginations
techniques: online ACI on observed world-model error
tldr: Calibrates latent safety filters online using directly observed discrepancies between predicted and observed latents, so the filter becomes pessimistic exactly when the world model is wrong.
relevance_reason: Addresses reliability of imagination-based safety monitors.

title: Deterministic World Models for Closed-loop Reachability Analysis of End-to-End Vision-based Control
tldr: Replaces the stochastic camera model with a deterministic state-to-image world model so closed-loop reachability of end-to-end vision controllers can be verified, with conformal bounds transferring guarantees to the real system.
relevance_reason: World models for formal safety verification.

title: How Well Do Latent World Models Understand Partially Observable Safety Constraints?
tldr: Identifies estimation and prediction gaps where latent world models fail to encode safety-relevant information and proposes diagnostics and mitigations for latent safety filters.
relevance_reason: When imagination-based safety monitors can fail.

title: Calibrated Predictive Safety for Heterogeneous Robots: An Action-Conditioned JEPA Framework with Model-Based Safety Shields
tldr: Receding-horizon pipeline that rolls candidate action chunks through an action-conditioned JEPA to score calibrated risk and progress, with a deterministic embodiment-specific shield providing hard guarantees.
relevance_reason: Latent world model as pre-execution safety monitor for VLA outputs.

title: Pixels to Proofs: Probabilistically-Safe Latent World Model Control via Parallel Conformal Robust MPC
techniques: system level synthesis robust MPC in latent space
tldr: Safe feedback planning from pixels via GPU-accelerated robust MPC in a compact JEPA latent space with conformally calibrated latent error bounds and a conformalized constraint checker.
relevance_reason: Probabilistic safety with efficient latent planning.

title: Foresight: Failure Detection for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation with Action-Conditioned World Model Latents
tldr: Policy-agnostic failure detector for long-horizon manipulation built on action-conditioned world-model latents, trained only on episode-level success labels and calibrated with functional conformal prediction.
relevance_reason: World-model-based runtime failure monitoring for VLAs.

title: MiraBench: Evaluating Action-Conditioned Reliability in Robotic World Models
techniques: hierarchical evaluation: physics, action fidelity, optimism bias
tldr: Benchmark testing whether robot world models follow commanded actions and correctly predict failure under failure-inducing actions, rather than just looking realistic.
relevance_reason: Measures optimism bias that undermines world-model safety monitoring.

title: Failure Detection for Surgical Robot Imitation Policies via Flow-Matching World Modeling
tldr: Detects surgical-robot policy failures without failure data by scoring how inconsistent observed latents are with a nominal action-conditioned flow-matching world model, calibrated conformally.
relevance_reason: World-model-based runtime monitoring.

title: FARM: Reading Failure Signals from the Internal Predictive States of a Frozen Robotic World Model
techniques: tiny supervised readout on frozen predictive states
reported_metric: 0.2256 ms mean added CUDA latency; pooled AUROC 85.7
tldr: Shows a frozen robotic world model's internal predictive states already encode failure; a 34k-parameter readout gives step-wise failure scores for ~0.2 ms extra latency.
relevance_reason: Near-free safety monitoring from world-model states.

title: Foundational World Models Accurately Detect Bimanual Manipulator Failures
techniques: probabilistic latent world model in Cosmos tokenizer space
tldr: Trains a probabilistic world model in a pretrained video tokenizer's latent space and uses its predictive uncertainty as a conformal runtime monitor for bimanual failures; releases a new bimanual dataset.
relevance_reason: World-model uncertainty for safety monitoring.

title: ContactGuard: Pre-Contact Execution Monitoring with Action-Conditioned Latent World Models
techniques: latent multi-view embedding prediction under planned chunk
tldr: Predicts the latent consequence of a policy's planned action chunk just before contact and aborts if a small probe flags likely failure, avoiding pixel video prediction.
relevance_reason: Cheap latent imagination for pre-execution safety.

title: Pre-VLA: Preemptive Runtime Verification for Reliable Vision-Language-Action and World-Model Rollouts
tldr: Scores candidate action chunks before they are executed or imagined, filtering unsafe ones and also saving the rendering cost of wasted world-model rollouts.
relevance_reason: Joint safety and compute saving for world-model rollouts.

title: DreamLedger: Where to Refuse World-Model Imagination Using Execution-Settled Credit
techniques: registering predictions as claims settled by outcomes
tldr: Keeps a ledger of past world-model predictions and their executed outcomes to decide when a new prediction should not be trusted, lowering failures per consumed prediction.
relevance_reason: Monitoring trustworthiness of world-model imagination.

title: DeltaWAM: Change-Centric Visual Foresight via Delta Tokens for an Efficient World-Action Model
techniques: one delta vector per future frame
flow-matching action expert on predicted transitions
tldr: Predicts a single compact delta token per future frame encoding change in DINO features instead of reconstructing whole scenes, giving a sub-1B WAM trained on just 256 GPU-hours.
relevance_reason: Very compact future representation for efficient WAMs.

title: DroneWAM: Efficient World Action Model for Drone Visual Navigation
tldr: JEPA-style WAM for drones that compresses features into few tokens and adaptively chooses imagination depth per scene to meet onboard efficiency limits.
relevance_reason: Compute-adaptive latent WAM for a constrained platform.

title: Think Like a World Model, Act Like a VLA: Distilling World-Model Representations into Compact Robot Policies
techniques: feature-alignment loss to cached frozen world-model features
reported_metric: deployed policy runs in 32 ms and 1.86 GB (identical cost to undistilled baseline)
tldr: Transfers world-model physical grounding into a compact VLA with a single feature-alignment term against precomputed world-model features, adding zero deployment cost (32 ms, 1.86 GB on RTX 5090).
relevance_reason: Gets world-model benefits without runtime world-model cost.

title: DualWAM: Dual-System World Action Models for Asynchronous Global Planning and Local Refinement
techniques: fast low-noise local refinement from intermediate state
tldr: Runs a slow global world-action denoiser periodically and a fast wrist-camera refiner that completes low-noise denoising from its intermediate state, giving high-frequency closed-loop updates.
relevance_reason: Dual-rate WAM for responsiveness.

title: DIDO: Distilling Interaction-Centric Dynamics into One-Step Denoising for World Action Models
tldr: Observes that one-step truncation of a video WAM keeps background but loses gripper-object dynamics, and distills converged interaction dynamics into a single denoising step.
relevance_reason: One-step distillation targeted at manipulation-relevant dynamics.

title: TacPAC: Tactile Prediction and Real-Time Action Correction in World-Action Models for Contact-Rich Manipulation
techniques: single-pass tactile correction of remaining actions
reported_metric: one correction pass 20.7x cheaper than regenerating the chunk
tldr: Corrects not-yet-executed actions in real time by comparing incoming tactile images with the contact the WAM plan anticipated, at 1/20 the cost of re-planning.
relevance_reason: Cheap reactive correction for slow WAMs.

title: FlowPilot: Real-Time World-Action Modeling for Agile UAV Navigation
tldr: Compact WAM for agile drone flight that co-trains on future depth prediction but outputs only smooth trajectories at deployment, running onboard in real time.
relevance_reason: Onboard real-time WAM.

title: SelfWAM: A Self-Grounded Unified World Action Model for Fast Robot Control
techniques: action-conditioned future video + self-mask prediction in training
tldr: Makes the training-time video branch model action-specific consequences (via robot self-masks) while keeping a fast action-only inference path.
relevance_reason: Better training signal for fast WAMs.

title: Enfold: Folding World Model Imagination into Predictive Representations for Ultra-Efficient Embodied Control
techniques: supervise current-only encoder with generator intermediate states
tldr: Internalizes a world generator's intermediate future-construction computation into a representation predicted from the present alone, so actions are produced without running the generator.
relevance_reason: Removes generative cost at deployment.

title: Learning 4D Geometric Priors for Inference-Efficient World Action Models
tldr: Injects 4D geometry priors into a WAM through a training-only expert, preserving the original lightweight inference graph.
relevance_reason: Geometry without inference cost.

title: WorldKV: Efficient World Memory with World Retrieval and Compression
techniques: retrieve evicted KV chunks by camera/action correspondence
reported_metric: halves per-chunk KV storage (2x history under fixed budget)
tldr: Training-free persistent memory for real-time AR world models: offloads and retrieves relevant KV chunks and prunes redundant tokens, keeping consistency without linear cost growth.
relevance_reason: Memory-efficient long rollouts.

title: S-VAM: Shortcut Video-Action Model by Self-Distilling Geometric and Semantic Foresight
techniques: self-distill multi-step VFM foresight into one step
tldr: Self-distills geometric and semantic foresight from multi-step generated videos into a single forward pass so the video-action model is both real-time and high-fidelity.
relevance_reason: One-step foresight distillation.

title: PACT-WAM: Predicting Actions and Visual Foresight with Compact Temporal Encoding for Robot Manipulation
tldr: Keeps 16 frames of history with 75% fewer tokens via hierarchical encoding and jointly samples actions with visual forecasts that a VLM can use to reject bad proposals.
relevance_reason: Token-efficient WAM with forecast-based rejection.

title: V-JEPA Policy: Building Effective World-Action Models on Predictive Visual Latents
tldr: Builds a 0.9B WAM on a frozen V-JEPA 2.1 latent space without inheriting a video generator, matching larger generator-based WAMs.
relevance_reason: Latent-JEPA route to small WAMs.

title: What Makes World Action Models Generalize? An Empirical Study of Test-Time Future Modeling
techniques: controlled comparison of explicit vs latent WAMs
tldr: Finds latent WAMs that drop future generation lose generalization, and that nearly all of the benefit comes from the first denoising step of the future, suggesting cheap partial imagination.
relevance_reason: Clarifies how little test-time imagination compute is needed.

title: Model-Based Runtime Monitoring with Interactive Imitation Learning
tldr: Learns a latent dynamics model plus failure classifier from deployment data to simulate outcomes of upcoming actions and flag risky states before failures occur.
relevance_reason: Foundational world-model-based runtime monitor.

title: Multi-Task Interactive Robot Fleet Learning with Visual World Models
techniques: visual world model predicting future outcomes
tldr: Fleet-learning system that uses a visual world model to forecast whether upcoming actions will lead to anomalies and asks humans for help only when needed, reducing supervision over time.
relevance_reason: World-model safety monitoring at fleet scale.

title: World Models That Know When They Don't Know - Controllable Video Generation with Calibrated Uncertainty
tldr: Trains controllable video world models to output dense, calibrated confidence maps so hallucinated predictions can be detected during policy evaluation and planning.
relevance_reason: Uncertainty for trustworthy world-model monitoring.

title: Safety, Security, and Cognitive Risks in World Models
techniques: survey/taxonomy of safety and security risks
tldr: Survey of safety, security and cognitive risks specific to world models, from data poisoning and compounding rollout errors to automation bias in human users.
relevance_reason: Risk framing for world-model-based safety.

title: TrojanWorld: Backdooring World-Model Agents via Imagination Steering
tldr: Shows pretrained world models can be backdoored so a physical object trigger steers the agent's imagination toward attacker-chosen behavior.
relevance_reason: Threat to imagination-based decision/safety pipelines.

title: TRAP: Tail-aware Ranking Attack for World-Model Planning
tldr: Identifies that world-model planners can be hijacked by perturbing the ranking of a few decision-critical imagined trajectories, and builds an attack exploiting it.
relevance_reason: Planning-security risk for world models.

title: World Models for Anomaly Detection during Model-Based Reinforcement Learning Inference
techniques: monitor world-model prediction error at inference
tldr: Uses discrepancy between a model-based RL world model's predictions and observations at deployment as a task-agnostic anomaly detector that can trigger an emergency stop.
relevance_reason: Simple, cheap world-model runtime monitor.

title: From Foresight to Forethought: VLM-In-the-Loop Policy Steering via Latent Alignment
techniques: latent world model predicts action outcomes
VLM aligned to latent space verifies
tldr: Uses a latent world model to predict outcomes of candidate action plans and a VLM aligned to that latent space to pick safe/correct ones at runtime.
relevance_reason: Imagination-based runtime steering for safety.

title: StressDream: Steering Video World Models for Robust Policy Evaluation and Improvement
techniques: initial-noise optimization of diffusion world model toward target events
tldr: Steers diffusion world-model imaginations toward plausible high-impact outcomes by optimizing initial noise, surfacing rare failures without drawing huge numbers of samples.
relevance_reason: Efficient rare-failure search with world models.

title: SafeDojo: Safe Reinforcement Learning for VLA via Interactive World Model
techniques: online safe RL inside video world model
tldr: Model-based safe RL for VLAs inside an interactive video world model, with a lightweight head predicting per-step safety costs from imagined frames.
relevance_reason: Imagination-based safety for VLA training.

title: ICAT: Incident-Case-Grounded Adaptive Testing for Physical-Risk Prediction in Embodied World Models
tldr: Benchmark grounded in real incident reports showing mainstream video world models downplay danger cues and miscalibrate severity for hazardous actions.
relevance_reason: Tests whether world models can serve as safety predictors.

title: DreamAvoid: Critical-Phase Test-Time Dreaming to Avoid Failures in VLA Policies
tldr: Invokes world-model 'dreaming' only in detected critical phases to evaluate several VLA action candidates and avoid failures, limiting imagination compute to where it matters.
relevance_reason: Selective imagination-based safety for VLAs.

title: Validate the Dream Before You Trust Its Verdict: Admissibility for World-Model Simulators
tldr: Argues world models used as safety or success oracles must first be accredited, and proposes admissibility checks beyond visual fidelity.
relevance_reason: Methodology for trusting world-model safety verdicts.

title: HaWMPO: Hallucination-Aware World Model-based Policy Optimization for Generalist Robot Policy
tldr: World-model RL pipeline for VLA post-training that detects and discounts hallucinated long-horizon transitions to avoid misleading policy updates.
relevance_reason: Reliability of imagined rollouts.

title: Causal-History Test-Time Scaling for Failure Recovery in Autoregressive World-Action Models
techniques: training-free revision of autoregressive causal history
tldr: Training-free failure recovery for autoregressive WAMs that decides when and where to rewrite the causal history after execution diverges.
relevance_reason: Runtime recovery for WAMs.

title: FACT: Failure-Aware Causal Training for World-Action Models
techniques: action-conditioned causal WAM trained on failure rollouts
tldr: Trains a causal WAM to predict video and task progress conditioned on executed actions, including failures, so it can anticipate consequences of bad actions.
relevance_reason: Makes WAM imagination usable for failure anticipation.

title: DreamGen: Unlocking Generalization in Robot Learning through Video World Models
tldr: NVIDIA pipeline that generates synthetic robot videos with a fine-tuned video world model and labels them with pseudo-actions, letting a humanoid learn 22 new behaviors from one-task teleop data.
relevance_reason: Offline world-model use (data generation) that moves compute off the robot.

title: Learning Universal Policies via Text-Guided Video Generation
tldr: Frames decision making as text-conditioned video generation followed by inverse dynamics; the first video-planning policy and the ancestor of today's slow imagine-then-act WAMs.
relevance_reason: Seminal video-as-plan work.

title: GAIA-2: A Controllable Multi-View Generative World Model for Autonomous Driving
tldr: Wayve's controllable multi-camera driving world model; uses an unusually aggressive 32x spatial compression tokenizer to cut token count and speed up inference.
relevance_reason: Tokenizer-level efficiency in a production world model.

title: Generative World Modelling for Humanoids: 1X World Model Challenge Technical Report
techniques: Wan-2.2 TI2V-5B with AdaLN state conditioning + LoRA
reported_metric: 23.0 dB PSNR (sampling); Top-500 CE 6.6386 (compression)
tldr: Winning technical report for the 1X humanoid world-model challenge, covering both pixel-sampling and discrete-token compression tracks.
relevance_reason: Benchmark for compact (tokenized) humanoid world models.

title: An Empirical Study of World Model Quantization
tldr: Systematic study of post-training quantization of a latent planning world model (DINO-WM), showing how bit-width, granularity and planning horizon interact.
relevance_reason: First quantization study specifically for world-model planning.

title: Where Bits Matter in World Model Planning: A Paired Mixed-Bit Study for Efficient Spatial Reasoning
tldr: Finds 8/6-bit DINO-WM planning is near FP16, 3-bit collapses, and at 4-bit keeping the encoder at higher precision matters most.
relevance_reason: Where to spend bits in world-model planners.

title: Predict Before You Deploy: Offline Prediction of Quantization-Induced Task Degradation for World Action Models
techniques: policy-calibrated thresholds on offline action deviation
tldr: Predicts which WAM quantization configurations will hurt closed-loop success using offline action deviations calibrated on a small development set, avoiding exhaustive rollouts.
relevance_reason: Makes WAM quantization search cheap.

title: SANA-WM: Efficient Minute-Scale World Modeling with Hybrid Linear Diffusion Transformer
tldr: 2.6B open world model with hybrid linear attention for memory-efficient minute-long 720p generation at quality comparable to much larger industrial models.
relevance_reason: Efficient long-context world-model architecture.

title: Light Interaction: Training-Free Inference Acceleration for Interactive Video World Models
tldr: Training-free inference acceleration for interactive world models that adapts memory, context and denoising reuse to the camera trajectory.
relevance_reason: General world-model inference acceleration.

title: KeyWorld: Key Frame Reasoning Enables Effective and Efficient World Models
tldr: Spends transformer compute only on a few semantically important key frames of a robot world-model rollout and fills the rest with a light convolutional model, speeding up generation.
relevance_reason: Temporal sparsity for efficient robot world models.

title: InternW0: A Foundational Physical World Model for Efficient Real-World Interactions
techniques: high-capacity video expert + light fast action expert
layerwise K/V reuse with observation adaptation
tldr: Shanghai AI Lab physical world model that runs a light action expert at a faster timescale than the video expert and reuses adapted K/V instead of regenerating the future each step.
relevance_reason: Multi-frequency WAM design.

title: DREAM-Chunk: Reactive Action Chunking with Latent World Model
tldr: Adds a small latent world model to chunked VLAs: several candidate chunks are rolled out and execution follows the one whose predicted state matches what is observed, improving reactivity.
relevance_reason: Cheap latent imagination for closed-loop robustness.

title: Unified Video Action Model
tldr: Learns a joint video-action latent but decodes actions with a separate light head, so policy inference can skip video generation and match direct policies in speed.
relevance_reason: Early decoupled-decoding WAM for fast inference.

title: Cache-Aware Conv3D Lowering Across Embedded World-Model Decoders
reported_metric: VAE decoding ~7x faster; full image-to-video generation latency >2x lower
tldr: Runtime-level rewrite of causal Conv3D ops as batched Conv2D that speeds up Cosmos edge world-model decoders ~7x on Jetson AGX Orin.
relevance_reason: On-device world-model rollout acceleration.

title: WISE: World-model-guided Imagination Scheduling for Efficient Post-training of Vision-Language-Action Models
tldr: Schedules world-model imagination only at execution stages where it helps and bounds horizons to reliable ranges, making world-model-based VLA post-training cheaper and more reliable.
relevance_reason: Compute-efficient use of imagination.

title: Prioritized Rollouts for Efficient World Model-based Vision-Language-Action Policy Optimization
tldr: Spends world-model rollout compute on states where the VLA policy is uncertain, reducing the cost of model-based RL fine-tuning.
relevance_reason: Rollout budget efficiency.

title: AcceRL: A Distributed Asynchronous Reinforcement Learning and World Model Framework for Vision-Language-Action Models
tldr: Distributed asynchronous RL framework for VLAs that removes synchronization bubbles and can plug in world models as rollout environments.
relevance_reason: Systems for world-model-based RL.

title: Diffusion for World Modeling: Visual Details Matter in Atari
tldr: RL agent trained entirely in a diffusion world model, showing few-step EDM sampling keeps the model fast enough for imagination while preserving visual details.
relevance_reason: Diffusion world models for imagination-based RL.

title: JEDI: Joint Embedding Diffusion World Model for Online Model-Based Reinforcement Learning
tldr: Online MBRL with a diffusion world model operating in an end-to-end learned JEPA latent space, avoiding the cost of pixel diffusion.
relevance_reason: Efficient latent diffusion world model.

title: FLARE: Robot Learning with Implicit World Modeling
techniques: future latent alignment tokens in diffusion policy
tldr: NVIDIA method that adds a few tokens to a VLA trained to predict future observation embeddings, gaining world-model foresight with negligible inference cost.
relevance_reason: Implicit world modeling at near-zero runtime cost.

title: WorldGuide: Learning Success-Failure Boundaries in Latent World Models for Vision-Language-Action Policies
tldr: Learns a latent world model that separates similar-looking successes and failures and uses it as a differentiable reward during VLA training; nothing extra runs at deployment.
relevance_reason: World-model failure knowledge without runtime cost.

title: AnyStep-WAM: Budget-Aligned Distillation and Adaptive Inference for World Action Models
techniques: interval-conditioned flow-map distillation with shared LoRA
tldr: Distills a WAM so one model can generate actions with anywhere from one to many steps, then uses a light risk estimator to spend more steps only on precision-critical chunks.
relevance_reason: Adaptive-compute WAM inference tied to risk.

title: LiMA: Bridging Long-term Imagination to Real-time Dexterous Manipulation via Asynchronous Diffusion
tldr: Dual-system generative framework where a slow system imagines sparse long-horizon intent and a fast system reacts to contact changes for real-time dexterous manipulation.
relevance_reason: Slow-fast decoupling of WAM imagination.

title: AcrossWAM1.0:A Modular Latent World-Action Stack for Compact Robot Policies
techniques: training-only teachers separated from inference graph
tldr: Modularizes the LaWAM latent world-action stack with explicit boundaries and a deployment export that excludes training-only teachers, for compact robot policies.
relevance_reason: Engineering of compact latent WAMs.

title: LiLa-WAM: Lightweight Latent Reasoning World-Action Model for Robotic Manipulation
tldr: Compact latent-space WAM trainable end-to-end on one 24 GB GPU, avoiding pixel-level prediction and multi-stage latent construction.
relevance_reason: Low-cost WAM training and inference.

title: C$^3$ache: Accelerating World Action Models with Cross Inference Chunk Cache
techniques: reuse denoising residuals across consecutive inference chunks
tldr: Exploits that denoising residuals are highly correlated between consecutive WAM chunks during smooth behavior, caching them across chunks to cut inference cost.
relevance_reason: New axis of caching for WAM inference.

title: SWEET: Sparse World Modeling with Image Editing for Embodied Task Execution
techniques: image-editing model predicts task-level future keyframes
tldr: Shows an image-editing model predicting a few task-level keyframes is a cheaper and more reliable visual world model for manipulation than dense video generation.
relevance_reason: Sparse visual foresight for efficiency.

title: Privileged Foresight Distillation: Zero-Cost Future Correction for World Action Models
techniques: distill privileged-future action-denoising residual into current-only policy
tldr: Models what the future branch contributes as a residual correction to action denoising and distills it into a current-only WAM, recovering the benefit at zero inference cost.
relevance_reason: Zero-cost future correction for WAMs.

title: WorldCache: Content-Aware Caching for Accelerated Video World Models
tldr: Training-free caching for DiT video world models that decides when and how to reuse features based on motion and saliency, avoiding ghosting of naive caching.
relevance_reason: Inference acceleration for video world models.

title: SKIP: Sparse Keyframe Interpolation Paradigm for Efficient Embodied World Models
tldr: Generates only task-relevant keyframes (approach, contact, grasp, release) and interpolates the rest, avoiding frame-by-frame rollout cost.
relevance_reason: Temporal sparsity for robot world models.

title: Planning in 8 Tokens: A Compact Discrete Tokenizer for Latent World Model
techniques: discrete tokenizer compressing observation to ~8 tokens
tldr: Compresses each observation into as few as 8 discrete tokens so an action-conditioned world model can plan at decision time orders of magnitude cheaper.
relevance_reason: Extreme token compression for real-time planning.

title: Fast LeWorldModel
techniques: parallel prediction of latents for all action prefixes
