tldr: Replaces step-by-step latent rollout in a JEPA world model with parallel prediction of the latent reached after each action prefix, speeding planning and reducing error accumulation.
relevance_reason: Faster JEPA planning.

title: Behavioral Monitoring of JEPA World Models with Jacobian Centroids
tldr: Monitors whether a JEPA world model used for planning is behaviorally aligned with the task using cheap Jacobian-based centroids of its internal representations.
relevance_reason: Monitoring planning world models.

title: Beyond One-Step Accuracy: State-Affine Latent Transition for Reliable Visual Planning
tldr: Shows state-affine latent transitions remove nonlinear error propagation in recursive rollouts, improving reliability of JEPA visual planning.
relevance_reason: Reliable latent planning.

title: Where World Models Break: Natural-Input Failure Discovery
techniques: budgeted search for catastrophic condition-action inputs
tldr: Formulates and solves budgeted search for natural conditions and action prefixes under which a world model's predictions collapse, before those errors reach planning or safety pipelines.
relevance_reason: Validating world models used for safety.

title: Biased Dreams: Limitations to Epistemic Uncertainty Quantification in Latent Dynamics Models
techniques: analysis of ensemble disagreement in latent rollouts
tldr: Finds ensemble disagreement in Dreamer-style latent models tracks local but not accumulated rollout error because of an attractor effect, questioning its use as a safety signal.
relevance_reason: Limits of uncertainty-based world-model safety monitors.

title: World Model Control by Trajectory Reachability Metrics
techniques: learned temporal pairwise cost for ranking predicted endpoints
tldr: Adds a small learned reachability cost to rank latent-world-model rollouts, raising LeWorldModel TwoRoom success from 7% to 97%.
relevance_reason: Planning cost for latent world models.

title: Sandwich-Residuals: Parameter-Efficient Test-time Adaptation of World Models
techniques: small online residual corrections around frozen predictor
tldr: Adapts a frozen latent world model at test time with tiny residual modules trained on its own prediction error, improving planning under shift without touching most parameters.
relevance_reason: Parameter-efficient adaptation of planning world models.

title: CorrRisk-WM: Corridor-Conditioned Risk World Modeling for Safety-Critical Trajectory Planning
techniques: latent environment model + recurrent per-candidate risk module
tldr: Planning-oriented partial world model predicting per-candidate-trajectory intrusion and near-miss probabilities for safety-critical local planning.
relevance_reason: World-model-based risk estimation for planning.

title: CrossSafe: Towards Cross-Embodiment Latent Safety Filters
techniques: shared latent safety reasoning with embodiment-specific realization
tldr: Proposes a single latent safety filter that shares safety reasoning across robots while realizing safe actions per embodiment.
relevance_reason: Scaling latent safety filters across embodiments.

title: Towards General Language-Conditioned Latent Safety Filters
techniques: language-conditioned HJ safety actor/critic in latent space
tldr: Conditions latent HJ safety filters on natural-language constraints so one filter can enforce different user-specified safety requirements.
relevance_reason: Generalizable latent safety filters.

title: Safe Control using Learned Safety Filters and Adaptive Conformal Inference
techniques: adaptive conformal inference on learned safety filter switching
tldr: Adjusts the switching threshold of learned HJ safety filters online with adaptive conformal inference to bound the rate of wrong safety decisions.
relevance_reason: Calibration technique reused by world-model safety filters.

title: How to Train Your Latent Control Barrier Function: Smooth Safety Filtering Under Hard-to-Model Constraints
techniques: latent CBF training from reachability values
tldr: Shows current latent reachability values are poor CBFs and proposes training that yields smooth latent CBFs for minimally invasive safety filtering of visuomotor policies.
relevance_reason: Improves world-model latent safety filters.

title: Safety Certification in the Latent space using Control Barrier Functions and World Models
techniques: neural barrier + safe controller learned in world-model latent space
tldr: Learns control barrier certificates and a safe controller in a world model's latent space with little labeled safety data.
relevance_reason: World-model latent safety certification.

title: World Model Failure Classification and Anomaly Detection for Autonomous Inspection
techniques: world model backbone on compressed video
tldr: Policy-agnostic world-model-based monitor that labels inspection runs as success, known failure or anomaly using conformal thresholds.
relevance_reason: World-model runtime monitoring in the field.

title: Uncertainty-Aware World Model for Aerial Image-Goal Navigation
techniques: trajectory scoring as conditional OOD detection
tldr: Efficient latent navigation world model for UAVs that represents a subspace of plausible futures and scores trajectories via OOD detection instead of a few point predictions.
relevance_reason: Uncertainty-aware efficient latent planning.

title: Communication-Aware and Safety-Aware UAV Control via Predictive Latent Models
techniques: JEPA multi-step rollouts with probabilistic safety constraints
tldr: Uses a JEPA latent model's multi-step rollouts to anticipate collision risk and link degradation for jointly safe and energy-aware UAV control.
relevance_reason: Predictive latent safety control.

title: SpikeWorld: Fast-State Adaptation for Frozen Spiking World Models
tldr: Tiny 1.45M-parameter spiking world model that adapts after deployment through external residual paths without changing frozen weights.
relevance_reason: Ultra-small world model suited to neuromorphic/edge settings.

title: GaussianDream++: Efficient 3D Gaussian World Modeling for Robotic Manipulation
tldr: Compact redesign of GaussianDream that keeps 3D Gaussian future-prediction supervision for VLAs while cutting deployment cost.
relevance_reason: Efficient 3D world-model supervision.

title: Targeting World Models to Compromise Robot Learning Pipelines
tldr: Shows poisoning a world model used for data generation or simulation can stealthily yield unsafe deployed robot policies even when the real training data is clean.
relevance_reason: Safety risk of world models in robot pipelines.

title: GE-Sim 2.0: A Roadmap Towards Comprehensive Closed-loop Video World Simulators for Robotic Manipulation
techniques: random-stride training for up to 4x frame skipping
tldr: AgiBot's second-generation closed-loop video world simulator with a state decoder and judge; random-stride training allows up to 4x frame skipping at inference to extend horizon cheaply.
relevance_reason: Efficient closed-loop neural simulator (Genie Envisioner line).

title: CKT-WAM: Parameter-Efficient Context Knowledge Transfer Between World Action Models
techniques: teacher hidden-state compression into text-embedding context
tldr: Transfers knowledge from a teacher WAM to a student WAM through a compact learned context in text-embedding space rather than dense distillation.
relevance_reason: Parameter-efficient WAM distillation.

title: Learned Perceptive Forward Dynamics Model for Safe and Platform-aware Robotic Navigation
tldr: Learned perceptive forward-dynamics world model that predicts a legged robot's future states from geometry and proprioception for real-time safe planning onboard.
relevance_reason: Onboard real-time world model for safe navigation.

title: An Efficient and Multi-Modal Navigation System with One-Step World Model
techniques: lightweight one-step generation instead of multi-step AR diffusion
tldr: Lightweight navigation world model with one-step prediction that makes world-model-based trajectory optimization fast enough for real-time robot navigation.
relevance_reason: One-step world model for real-time planning.

title: SLIM-0.5B: Learning Action-Grounded Predictive Latents for Robot Manipulation
tldr: 0.5B latent interaction model learning action-grounded predictive latents instead of using a large VLM backbone or pixel world model.
relevance_reason: Compact world-model-style policy.

title: Q-WAM: 4-Bit Quantization of World Action Models with Action-Subspace Protection
tldr: 4-bit weight-activation quantization for WAMs that measures how rounding errors in each channel combination propagate to final actions across denoising, and keeps the most action-sensitive subspace in higher precision.
relevance_reason: WAM-specific low-bit quantization.

title: Enhancing Physical Consistency in Lightweight World Models
tldr: Compact 400M physics-informed BEV world model that closes much of the gap to large world models for edge deployment in driving.
relevance_reason: Small world models for edge devices.

title: Beyond the Next Step: Variable-Length Latent World Models for Long-Horizon Planning
techniques: direct prediction from variable-length action sequences
tldr: Trains JEPA latent world models to jump directly to states after variable-length action sequences, avoiding recursive one-step rollouts in planning.
relevance_reason: Cheaper, more accurate latent planning.

title: Learning from Reward-Free Offline Data: A Case for Planning with Latent Dynamics Models
techniques: JEPA latent dynamics + planning vs offline RL
tldr: Compares offline RL with planning in a JEPA latent dynamics model on reward-free data, finding latent planning generalizes better to new tasks and layouts.
relevance_reason: Evidence for latent world-model planning.

title: HapticWAM: Distilling Imagined Touch into a World-Action Model without Inference-Time Tactile Sensing
techniques: teacher-student distillation of tactile contact prediction
tldr: Distills tactile-aware contact prediction from a teacher WAM into a student that needs no tactile sensor at deployment.
relevance_reason: Distillation for cheaper deployment sensing.

title: SLIP-VLA: Single-Step Latent Imagination for Policy Learning in Vision-Language-Action Models
techniques: one denoising update for dense future latents
tldr: Gives a VLA future awareness with a single denoising update producing dense future latents, avoiding multi-step imagination cost while closing the gap to multi-step methods.
relevance_reason: Cheap imagination inside VLA policies.

title: Efficient Robotic Policy Learning via Latent Space Backward Planning
techniques: backward subgoal planning in latent space from final goal
tldr: Plans coarse latent subgoals backward from the task goal instead of generating full future frames, keeping planning cheap and on-task for real-time long-horizon control.
relevance_reason: Efficient latent planning for policies.

title: ABot-World-0: Infinite Interactive World Rollout on a Single Desktop GPU
techniques: teacher forcing + ODE distillation to causal student
tldr: Action-conditioned interactive video world model distilled into a causal student that runs real-time, long-horizon closed-loop rollouts on a single desktop GPU.
relevance_reason: Cheap real-time interactive world model.

title: MiniWorld: Democratizing the Training of Video World Models from Scratch
techniques: native causal training without bidirectional pretraining
tldr: Recipe for training causal video world models from scratch cheaply, avoiding costly post-training/distillation of bidirectional video models.
relevance_reason: Lowers training cost of world models.

title: SkyDreamer: Interpretable End-to-End Vision-Based Drone Racing with Model-Based Reinforcement Learning
techniques: Dreamer world model decoding privileged state
tldr: First end-to-end vision drone-racing policy trained with an informed Dreamer world model that transfers sim-to-real and runs fully onboard.
relevance_reason: Onboard deployment of a world-model-trained policy.

title: Koopman Dreamer: Spectrally Constrained Latent Dynamics for Stable World-Model Imagination
tldr: Dreamer variant with spectrally constrained Koopman-style latent dynamics that limit error growth in long imagined rollouts.
relevance_reason: Structured latent dynamics for stable imagination.

title: DISK: Dynamic Inference SKipping for World Models
techniques: latent-difference skip tests in AR rollouts
reported_metric: 2x speedup on trajectory diffusion, 1.6x on video diffusion at equal planning error
tldr: Training-free adaptive step skipping for coupled video/trajectory diffusion world models that keeps closed-loop driving metrics while speeding rollouts 1.6-2x.
relevance_reason: Adaptive inference for world-model rollouts.

title: Accelerating Model-Based Reinforcement Learning with State-Space World Models
tldr: Uses state-space models as the world model in model-based RL to parallelize dynamics training and substantially cut wall-clock training time, validated on real quadrotor control.
relevance_reason: Faster world-model training for robot RL.

title: WPT: World-to-Policy Transfer via Online World Model Distillation
techniques: policy and reward distillation into student
tldr: Distills world-model reasoning into a lightweight student driving policy via a world-model-aligned reward, removing world-model inference overhead at runtime.
relevance_reason: Removes runtime world-model cost by distillation.

title: Do Androids Dream of Electric Fences? Safety-Aware Reinforcement Learning with Latent Shielding
techniques: shield using model-based agent's latent imagination
tldr: Early work using a model-based agent's latent world model to imagine future trajectories and block those violating formal safety specifications.
relevance_reason: Origin of imagination-based latent safety shields.

title: Dreaming when Necessary: Advancing World Action Models with Adaptive Multi-Modal Reasoning
techniques: router triggering textual or visual reasoning on demand
tldr: WAM with a lightweight router that invokes visual imagination only for fine-grained phases and textual reasoning at task transitions.
relevance_reason: Conditional imagination compute.

title: Being-H0.7: A Latent World-Action Model from Egocentric Videos
tldr: Brings future-aware reasoning into a VLA-style policy through learnable latent queries trained against future information, with no future frame generation at deployment.
relevance_reason: Latent WAM avoiding pixel prediction cost.

title: VLA-Reasoner: Empowering Vision-Language-Action Models with Reasoning via Online Monte Carlo Tree Search
techniques: online Monte Carlo tree search over world-model rollouts of VLA actions
tldr: Plug-in test-time planner that rolls out sampled VLA action trajectories in a world model and uses MCTS to pick foresighted actions for long-horizon tasks.
relevance_reason: Test-time world-model planning for VLAs (compute trade-off).
